model.role: valid local v1 pair after the Qwen3 follow-up stopped at fake-donor P1

inputs.ground_truth: archived canonical free-generation exact match on the same MGSM-dev rows; no new candidate generation and no test-set access

fixed_methods.suture: sum of utility adjoint-times-injection layer scores; risk is reported separately and is not used to post-hoc tune rankings
fixed_methods.injection_only: negative sum of donor-host residual injection norms; the sign convention prefers smaller changes and is fixed before reading outcomes
fixed_methods.adjoint_only: sum of utility adjoint L2 norms; donor direction is ignored
fixed_methods.parameter_movement: negative sum of host/donor LoRA parameter-distance norms per layer; the sign convention prefers smaller movement
fixed_methods.risk_readout: sum of layer scores formed with the fixed language-risk readout instead of the utility readout
fixed_methods.normalized_suture: sum of utility adjoint-times-injection scores divided per layer by injection norm plus 1e-12
fixed_methods.path_integrated_state: five-node trapezoidal path integral of the utility directional derivative along the straight host-state to donor-update path for each layer

metrics: Spearman with archived free-generation exact match
Pearson with archived free-generation exact match
Spearman with archived teacher-forced sequence log-probability
